message.content:
The value of $20 in British Pounds depends on the current USD/GBP exchange rate, which fluctuates throughout the day. As of the most recent rates (mid‑2024), the exchange rate is roughly **1 USD ≈ 0.75 GBP**. Using that rate:

\[
\$20 \times 0.75 \text{ GBP/USD} \approx £15
\]

So $20 is approximately **£15**.  

Keep in mind that the exact amount can vary slightly depending on the day’s market rate and any fees your bank or payment service may charge. If you need the precise figure for a specific transaction, it’s best to check a reliable financial news source or your banking app at the time of the conversion.
